attchmntText: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 25-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: VRAJ IRON AND STEEL LIMITED has fixed Wednesday, November 25, 2026, as the record date for determining shareholder eligibility for an interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27. The Board of Directors approved this at a meeting held on November 14, 2026. The interim dividend is Rs. 0.60 per share with a face value of Rs. 10 each. Payment will be made on or before December 13, 2026. The company is listed on NSE under the symbol VRAJ and on BSE under the code 544204. This notice is issued pursuant to Regulation 42 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 14, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 0.6 per equity share.
voiceSummary: VRAJ IRON AND STEEL LIMITED has declared an interim dividend of Rs. 0.60 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The dividend applies to shares with a face value of Rs. 10. Payment is due on or before December 13, 2026, to members listed as beneficial owners in depository records as of the record date, November 25, 2026. The Board of Directors approved this declaration during a meeting held on November 14, 2026. The meeting started at 03:33 p.m. and concluded at 05:39 p.m. The company is formerly known as VRAJ IRON AND STEEL PVT. LTD. and PHIL ISPAT PRIVATE LIMITED. Its BSE security code is 544204 and NSE symbol is VRAJ. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Priya Namdeo.

attchmntText: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, and declaration of interim dividend.
voiceSummary: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs. 0.601 per equity share. The record date is November 25, 2026, with disbursement on or before December 13, 2026. Standalone profit after tax for the half year was Rs. 191.55 million, compared to Rs. 145.01 million in the previous year. Consolidated profit after tax stood at Rs. 220.11 million versus Rs. 153.40 million previously. Revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 3,809.36 million. The company reported basic earnings per share of Rs. 5.81 on a standalone basis and Rs. 6.67 on a consolidated basis. The meeting was held on November 14, 2026.
